articles.title: The US has an Arctic warfare problem: not enough of the right kinds of weapons and tools
articles.summary: The US faces a significant strategic challenge in Arctic warfare, lacking suitable weapons and tools for reliable threat detection and rapid response in the freezing environment. This deficiency underscores the critical need for specialized military capabilities to address potential future conflicts and evolving geopolitical interests in the Arctic, demanding a focus on adapting defence strategies for extreme conditions.

articles.title: NCP minister Chhagan Bhujbal, his son and nephew discharged in PMLA case related to Maharashtra Sadan scam
articles.summary: A special court in Mumbai discharged Maharashtra Cabinet minister and NCP leader Chhagan Bhujbal from a money laundering case filed by the Enforcement Directorate (ED). This development marks a significant legal relief for Bhujbal, who had been under scrutiny for alleged illicit financial transactions. The discharge, coming from a case involving a prominent political figure, carries implications for the state's political dynamics.

articles.title: Refunds not enough: Delhi HC asks IndiGo to spell out passenger compensation
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has directed IndiGo to submit a detailed compensation plan for passengers affected by last December's widespread flight cancellation chaos. The court observed that merely issuing refunds for tickets is insufficient and does not adequately address the inconvenience and additional costs incurred by passengers. This ruling highlights the need for stronger consumer protection in civil aviation beyond just ticket reimbursement.
